hints.allowSelfRegistration: When off, the sign-up page is closed: only administrators create accounts.
hints.enableNotifications: When off, no more reminders, announcements or team reports. Account and security emails (creation, activation, password) are still sent.
hints.enableChat: When off, messaging disappears from the menu and is unavailable to everyone.
hints.enableLiveSessions: When off, live sessions, their administration and their reminders are suspended.
hints.languageTimezone: The language applies to users who haven't picked one. The time zone is used for reports, streaks and schedules.
hints.maxUsersPerGroup: Applies when creating chat group conversations (creator included).
hints.certificateValidity: Used when no duration is given when a certificate is issued.

security.title: Access & security
security.invalidDomains: One of the email domains is invalid (expected e.g. belife.ci).

hints.requireRegistrationApproval: When on, a self-registered account waits for its manager to activate it. Otherwise it is active right away.
hints.passwordRequireComplexity: Requires an uppercase and a lowercase letter, a digit and a special character.
hints.passwordMinLength: Between 8 and 64 characters. Applies to new passwords.
hints.passwordExpiryDays: 0 = never. When due, users must choose a new one when they log in.
hints.maxLoginAttempts: 0 = no lockout. The account is locked after that many wrong passwords in a row.
hints.lockoutMinutes: An administrator can also unlock the account from the user list.
hints.sessionIdleMinutes: A warning shows one minute before the logout.
hints.sessionMaxDays: Past this, users must log in again, even while active.
hints.allowedEmailDomains: Comma-separated. Empty = any. Applies to self-registration and first SSO/LDAP logins; accounts created by an administrator are not affected.

learning.title: Learning & gamification
learning.assignmentReminderDays: First reminder (days before the due date)
learning.assignmentUrgentDays: Last reminder (days before the due date)

hints.quizDefaultPassingScore: Suggested when a quiz is created; each quiz can still be changed.
hints.quizDefaultMaxAttempts: 0 = unlimited. Suggested when a quiz is created.
hints.assignmentReminderDays: Mandatory courses with a due date. 0 = no first reminder.
hints.escalationDaysOverdue: The manager is told when the course is still not completed. 0 = never.
hints.enableBadges: When off, no badge is awarded automatically any more and the Badges page leaves the menu.
hints.enableXp: When off, level, XP and leaderboard disappear from the dashboard and the profile.
hints.leaderboardScope: Who each learner is compared with on the dashboard.

hints.auditLogRetentionDays: 0 = kept forever. Older entries are deleted every night.
hints.anonymizeDeletedUsers: When an account is deleted, its name, email, phone, photo, notifications and messages are erased. Its training results stay, no longer linked to the person.
hints.privacyPolicyUrl: Shown on sign-up and in the account menu.
hints.privacyContactEmail: Where users exercise their rights (access, correction, erasure).
hints.legalNotice: Shown on the public "Legal notice" page.
